name: dsh-hub-cli-workspace
description: Open-source CLI, schemas, resolver, and DSH agent tools for DSH Plugin Hub

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/schemas build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/registry build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/cli build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/schemas typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/registry typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin-hub/cli typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && node --test packages/*/tests/*.test.ts packages/*/tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm pack:check
